title: Pepa's Penguin Cliff: drawn by hand
kaylee: Pepa's cliff, the bay and everyone on it are drawn by hand now: the generated pictures are gone, and the penguins, the chicks and Lobo have a softer look with no black outlines.
questions: Luna's Fluffy Day is Peru's last level with generated pictures (and Peru's map is one too). Redraw them next?
